{{Quote|Allow me to present our mission commander, Lord Gaalan.|Lord Gaalan's aide|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
'''Viun Gaalan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] who was admired by others for his physical beauty. In [[43 ABY]], [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Gaalan led a [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] dispatched from the [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|Tribe's armada]] to the surface of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] to parley with the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] clan of [[Witches of Dathomir|witches]]. Expecting all of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to be female, the leader of the Nightsisters, [[Dresdema]], ordered her witches to [[Skirmish in the Dathomir landing meadow|attack]] Gaalan's forces once she realized that they were being led by a man. While the Nightsisters were quickly defeated, captured, and taken off-world by the Sith, Gaalan's own departure was delayed by the arrival of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and two others. Gaalan and Skywalker [[Duel in the Dathomir landing meadow|dueled intensely]] while several of the Sith Lord's remaining companions were cut down by Skywalker's associates, forcing him to retreat to the safety of his shuttle and flee the battlefield.

==Biography==
===Mission to Dathomir===
Viun Gaalan was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]].<ref name="Backlash" /> Gaalan was also [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]], and his ability to manipulate its [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], combined with his unblemished physical appearance, eventually earned him the rank of [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] within Kesh's [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].<ref name="Beauty">In both ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'' and ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'', [[Vestara Khai]] muses over the fact that physical beauty and strength in the Force are necessary for advancement within the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].</ref>

[[File:Dathomir.jpg|thumb|left|275px|Gaalan went on a mission to Dathomir.]]
In [[43 ABY]],<ref name="terc">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Gaalan was a member of a team that was sent by the Lost Tribe to the [[Dathomir system/Legends|Dathomir system]] to retrieve the stranded [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Vestara Khai]]. Khai was the sole survivor of a [[Lost Tribe of Sith strike team|strike force]] that had been recently dispatched to [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]] [[Black hole/Legends|black hole]] cluster on a [[Skirmish at Sinkhole Station|mission to kill]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]]. She fled to the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], made contact with the Tribe, and made plans for them to rescue her. Khai had also arranged for a group of [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Witches of Dathomir|witches]] to be collected by Gaalan's team for transport back to Kesh.<ref name="Backlash" />

At the appointed time, Gaalan led a vanguard of [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] to Dathomir's surface, where he was introduced by his [[Viun Gaalan's aide|aide]] to [[Dresdema]], leader of twenty-two Nightsisters and eighteen of their pet [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]]. The witches were expecting all of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to be female and perceived Gaalan's obviously male identity as an act of treachery. Dresdema gave an order for her sisters to attack, forcing Gaalan and the Sith [[Skirmish in the Dathomir landing meadow|into battle]]. He immediately set upon the nearest rancor, using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Force jump/Legends|propel]] himself onto the beast's shoulder. He then [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitated]] the rancor with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], while his companions [[Death/Legends|killed]] the remaining rancors and incapacitated all of the Nightsisters.<ref name="Backlash" />

===Duel with the Grand Master===
{{Quote|I am Lord Viun Gaalan, the last man you will ever meet. Much admiration will be accorded me for killing Luke Skywalker. Especially by the family of Lady Rhea, whom you slew.''"<br />"''No, you aren't, and no, it won't.|Viun Gaalan and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
[[File:Vestara.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Gaalan was sent to retrieve Khai.]]
As the witches were being bound and taken to the shuttles, Gaalan was approached by Vestara Khai, who advised the Sith Lord of an [[Halliava Vurse|additional Nightsister]] whom she had captured. Gaalan praised her and took from her a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] that held the coordinates to the Maw Cluster, the home of a [[Abeloth|mysterious dark side being]] whom Khai had encountered while in pursuit of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. He then allowed the apprentice to recover her captive but was confronted shortly thereafter by Luke Skywalker and his son, [[Ben Skywalker|Ben]]&mdash;who had followed Khai to Dathomir&mdash;and their Force-sensitive comrade [[Dyon Stadd]].<ref name="Backlash" />

After he introduced himself to the elder Skywalker, Gaalan declared that he would be the agent of the Jedi Grand Master's death, and would also exact revenge on behalf of Lady [[Olaris Rhea]], whom Skywalker had killed at [[Sinkhole Station]]. When the Jedi dismissed Gaalan's proclamation, the Sith Lord ignited his red-bladed lightsaber and lunged at his opponent. His aide joined him in the assault against Skywalker, but Gaalan soon found himself alone against the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], as his aide was knocked aside. His aide and the two other Sith, a [[Unidentified male Sith Saber (Viun Gaalan)|male]] and a [[Unidentified female Sith Saber|female]] [[Sith Saber|Saber]], then engaged Stadd and Ben Skywalker during the [[Duel in the Dathomir landing meadow|fight]]. Gaalan matched Skywalker blow-for-blow, but the other Sith quickly fell to Ben Skywalker and Stadd. As Khai returned to the scene to aid the Sith, Gaalan capitalized on a moment of Skywalker's distraction to retreat to the safety of his shuttle. He immediately closed the hatch and sped away while using the Force to [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinetically]] counter and nullify Skywalker's Force grip on the shuttle.<ref name="Backlash" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Welcome to school.|Lord Gaalan, patronizing Dresdema|<ref name="Backlash" />}}
Viun Gaalan was a tall, lean, broad-shouldered, [[Color/Legends|lavender]]-skinned Keshiri male who possessed a physical beauty that was highly respected by the members of the Lost Tribe. Indeed, his flawless features contributed to his ascension to the rank of Sith Lord, which was a common occurrence among the upper echelons of the Sith. Women such as Vestara Khai and the Nightsister Dresdema considered him exceedingly attractive, although the latter was not so moved by his appearance that she felt obliged to abandon<ref name="Backlash" /> the Dathomiri belief in feminine superiority.<ref name="EGTTF">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] entry on the [[Witches of Dathomir]]</ref>

Gaalan spoke with a cultured,<ref name="Backlash" /> rich, and melodious voice that was unnervingly pleasant,<ref name="Voice">In ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]'', [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] notes how each member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] with whom he had had contact spoke with rich, beautiful, melodious voices.</ref> and conveyed an air of preeminence. He regarded the Nightsisters as savages and was disappointed with being assigned to escort them back to Kesh. He did little to acknowledge the presence of Sith apprentices such as Vestara Khai, and like other Sith Lords, his face remained expressionless during casual conversation, even in the midst of joking. Gaalan did, however, voice his approval of Khai's actions and openly commended her success upon their meeting in the Dathomir landing meadow. He nevertheless considered Khai expendable and chose to ensure only his own survival when he escaped to his shuttle and left Khai to the mercy of the Jedi.<ref name="Backlash" />

Gaalan was interested in achieving greater status within the Lost Tribe and believed such honor would be bestowed upon him were he able to kill Luke Skywalker. He also actively sought to avenge the death of Lady Rhea by ending Skywalker's life, but he was unsuccessful in completing that goal.<ref name="Backlash" />

==Powers and abilities==
Viun Gaalan displayed notable ability with his red-bladed lightsaber, using it to behead a rancor in one fell swoop. His [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueling]] prowess was slightly inferior to Grand Master Skywalker's, whose blade came increasingly close to striking the Sith Lord, before Gaalan was forced to flee. Skywalker believed that while Gaalan's [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat skills]] were probably enough to contend with Jedi [[swordmaster]]s such as [[Kyp Durron]] or [[Kyle Katarn]], he would have been more than a match for the reserved dueling style of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] Master [[Cilghal]], or even Skywalker himself, had the Grand Master had to face Gaalan immediately after his time [[beyond shadows]] in the Maw.<ref name="Backlash" />

Gaalan also demonstrated considerable strength in the Force and used it to perform feats of great acrobatic skill. He was able to leap to great heights when fighting a rancor before alighting with flawless balance. He was also able to telekinetically resist and counter the Force grip of Luke Skywalker while escaping in his shuttle.<ref name="Backlash" />

==Behind the scenes==
Viun Gaalan first appeared in [[Aaron Allston]]'s [[2010]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Backlash]]'', the fourth installment in the ''[[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi]]'' series.<ref name="Backlash" />
